inj.note: Unsurprisingly, the Cardinals have opted to appoint Minshew to the top spot on the depth chart after he came on in relief of a struggling Jacoby Brissett and led a stirring comeback in Sunday's 33-30 overtime win over the Cowboys. In what was his first appearance of the season, Minshew completed 17 of 23 pass attempts for 188 yards and three touchdowns in just under two quarters' worth of action before Chad Ryland sealed the victory with a walk-off 42-yard field goal. Though his performance in future games will ultimately dictate how long he sticks around as the Cardinals' starter, Minshew is far from a lock to hold down the job for the balance of the season. If the 3-5 Cardinals eventually fade from playoff contention, LaFleur may want to give an extended look to rookie third-round pick Carson Beck, who will serve as Minshew's top backup in Week 9 while Brissett falls to third on the depth chart, per Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site.

news.h: Cardinals name Gardner Minshew as starter, move Jacoby Brissett to QB3
news.d: The Cardinals named Gardner Minshew as the team's new starting QB while moving Jacoby Brissett below rookie Carson Beck on the depth chart.

news.h: Cardinals' LaFleur noncommittal on QB after Minshew replaces Brissett in win
news.d: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur wouldn't commit to next week's starting quarterback after Gardner Minshew replaced Jacoby Brissett in the third quarter Sunday and led Arizona to a comeback win over Dallas.

news.h: Chad Ryland kicks winner after PAT miss that forced OT as Cards beat Cowboys 33-30 with wild rally
news.d: — Tyler Allgeier jolted his Arizona offense, which gave Gardner Minshew and Michael Wilson a chance to stun the Dallas Cowboys.
